step1_label: Paste the report or drag and drop a file
step1_placeholder:
Paste the report content (txt / csv)...

Extension IDs are 32 characters (letters a-p) and can be detected anywhere in the text.
step1_hint: You can also drop a .txt / .csv / .log / .json file onto the box.
step2_summary: {count} unique IDs found in the report.
csv_hint: The CSV respects the active filter and only includes already checked IDs.
step4_hint: Synchronizes the checked extensions (Active/Removed) from this session with the blocklist repository (blocklist.csv + blocklist.txt).
sync_hint: The token is only sent to api/sync.php and is not stored.
toast_no_ids: No valid extension IDs found (32 characters, letters a-p).
toast_all_checked: All IDs have already been checked.
toast_no_csv_results: No checked results to export with current filter.
toast_csv_partial: CSV includes {count} rows; {remaining} IDs remain unchecked.
toast_no_checked: No checked results (Active/Removed) in current session.
toast_sync_error_config: Server is not configured (ADMIN_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, GH_REPO in config.php).
toast_server_problem: The api/check.php endpoint is not responding correctly. Check that you uploaded the api/ folder and that config.php exists (copy config.sample.php).
